rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing a person who spends carefully and avoids waste.

example.english: They are very economical and always compare prices before buying things.
example.traditional: 佢好慳家，買嘢之前一定格價。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 haan1 gaa1 maai5 je5 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 gaak3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a product or choice that offers good value while saving money or resources.

example.english: This washing machine is economical, saves electricity, and lasts a long time.
example.traditional: 呢部洗衣機經濟實惠，慳電之餘又襟用。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sai2 ji1 gei1 ging1 zai3 sat6 wai6 haan1 din6 zi1 jyu4 jau6 gam1 jung6

rows.note: Use this specifically when an economical purchase is good value for its price.

example.english: These sneakers are on sale, so they are really economical.
example.traditional: 呢對波鞋做緊特價，真係抵買。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi3 bo1 haai4 zou6 gan2 dak6 gaa3 zan1 hai6 dai2 maai5

rows.note: Use this for a vehicle or engine that consumes little fuel.

example.english: This car is quite economical on fuel; one tank lasts a long time.
example.traditional: 呢架車幾慳油，入一次油可以行好耐。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 gei2 haan1 jau4 jap6 jat1 ci3 jau2 ho2 ji5 haang4 hou2 noi6
